newsitem.title: USA: SatCon Technology says gets $1 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: SatCon Technology says gets $1 mln contract.

text.p: SatCon Technology Corp said Wednesday it received a contract for $1 million from a "major aircraft engine manufacturer" to continue its development of magnetic bearings for aircraft turbine engines.
The company did not disclose the name of the engine manufacturer.
The company said the work was initially started in support of the integrated high performance turbine engine technology program with the Air Force.
The company said the new contract is meant to further develop magnetic bearings for incorporation into new aircraft engines.
